pages.title: Causal Shield Lattice
pages.text: Chronosteel threaded with stored chronons. Paradoxes that strike it are deflected into somebody else's timeline instead of mine. It is cool, faintly ticking, and slightly out of sync with the world around it.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Chronon Field Inverter, I threaded Chronon Capacitors through Chronosteel with Chronon Gas. When a paradox hit the lattice, it slid off into another history and left mine alone.

Made in $(item)Chronon Field Inverter$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Chronodynamics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Anomaly Containment Ward, Causal Shielding Plate, Chronal Accelerator, Contained Anomaly Specimen, Entangled Bus Bar, Quarantine Field Matrix.
